--- title: "Robust model pieces" subtitle: "Downweight outliers before they reach the GLM seam." jupyter: python3 execute: freeze: auto --- A single bad time point — a swallow, a big head movement — can pull an ordinary least-squares estimate toward itself, because OLS minimizes *squared* residuals and large residuals dominate that sum. Robust fitting limits this: estimate a residual scale that is itself resistant to outliers, then downweight any time point whose residual is implausibly large for that scale, and refit. The full estimator is `fmri_rlm(...)`; this page opens up the two primitives it is built from so you can see exactly what "downweight an outlier" means numerically. ## Robust Scale and Weights ::: {#e22c72b1 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import numpy as np import pandas as pd from fmrimod.robust import bisquare_weights, huber_weights, mad_scale residuals = np.array([ [0.10, 0.20], [0.00, -0.10], [0.20, 0.10], [5.00, -4.00], # a visible outlier in both voxels [-0.10, 0.00], ]) scale = mad_scale(residuals, axis=0) scale.round(3) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` array([0.148, 0.148]) ``` ::: ::: Huber weights shrink the outlier; bisquare weights can drop it completely. Ordinary residuals retain weight near one. ::: {#64fc8528 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} weights = pd.DataFrame({ "residual_voxel_1": residuals[:, 0], "huber_voxel_1": huber_weights(residuals, scale)[:, 0], "bisquare_voxel_1": bisquare_weights(residuals, scale)[:, 0], }) weights.round(3) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ```{=html}
residual_voxel_1 huber_voxel_1 bisquare_voxel_1
0 0.1 1.000 0.959
1 0.0 1.000 1.000
2 0.2 0.997 0.841
3 5.0 0.040 0.000
4 -0.1 1.000 0.959
``` ::: ::: ## Where This Fits Use robust fitting when a small number of high-residual time points would otherwise dominate a voxel-wise estimate. The authored model stays the same; the estimator changes how much influence each time point gets during the refit. ## Next - [Linear model](linear-model.qmd) - [Sketched and AR-aware models](sketched-ar-models.qmd)
